target.title: fix(google): resolve thought_signature gate for Gemini latest aliases
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100566 — Google Gemini `thought_signature` 400 regression when using `-latest` model aliases (`gemini-flash-latest`, `gemini-pro-latest`, `gemini-flash-lite-latest`).

## Why This Change Was Made

The `requiresToolCallThoughtSignature()` gate used a naive `.includes("gemini-3")` string check that does not match the `-latest` aliases, which resolve to Gemini 3 family models but don't contain `"gemini-3"` in their ID. When the gate returned `false`, the required `thought_signature` was not replayed on tool calls, causing Google's API to return a 400 error: *"Function call is missing a thought_signature"*.

The fix reuses existing `isGoogleGemini3ProModel()` and `isGoogleGemini3FlashModel()` helpers which already handle `-latest` aliases correctly via regex.

## User Impact

Users on `google/gemini-flash-latest` (and other `-latest` aliases) can now use tool-calling agents without hitting the 400 thought_signature error.

## Evidence

- ClawSweeper confirmed root cause and fix direction: [#100566](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100566#issuecomment-4888681439)
- `extensions/google/transport-stream.test.ts` — **83 passed** (3 new parameterized tests for `-latest` aliases)
- `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts` — **289 passed** (3 new parameterized tests for `-latest` aliases)
- `extensions/google/thinking.test.ts` — 23 passed
- `extensions/google/provider-models.test.ts` — 27 passed

## Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `extensions/google/transport-stream.ts:163` | `.includes("gemini-3")` → `isGoogleGemini3ProModel \|\| isGoogleGemini3FlashModel` (already-imported helpers) |
| `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.ts:3976` | Same fix + add import for the two helpers |
| `extensions/google/transport-stream.test.ts` | Parameterized regression tests for 3 `-latest` aliases |
| `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts` | Parameterized regression tests for 3 `-latest` aliases |
